fields.label: Key ID
fields.help: The key identifier of a private key enabled with DeviceCheck, created in your Apple Developer account.

fields.label: Private Key
fields.help: The contents of the private key (.p8) file associated with the key specified by keyId.

fields.label: Token Ttl
fields.help: Specifies the duration for which App Check tokens exchanged from DeviceCheck artifacts will be valid.
